items.title: Kyle Monangai: Dozen touches in Week 2 loss
items.description:
Monangai carried the ball 10 times for 47 yards and caught both his targets for 11 yards in Sunday's 9-3 loss to the Vikings.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Suffers hamstring injury
items.description:
Dobbins exited Sunday's game versus the Jaguars due to a hamstring injury, Sam Jane of The Denver Post reports.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Falls just short of 100 scrimmage yards
items.description:
Swift carried the ball 16 times for 45 yards and caught all five of his targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 9-3 loss to the Vikings.

items.title: Jayden Daniels: Won't return vs. Dallas
items.description:
Daniels has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cowboys due to a left elbow injury.

items.title: Cooper Rush: Benched after rough showing
items.description:
Rush completed 10 of 17 passes for 86 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while rushing twice for 20 yards before being benched with in the third quarter of the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
